# MoonsteelPretty

> Moved out of `CLAUDE.md` on 2026-10-13. Text is verbatim; `[verified]` marks and dates are as originally recorded.

- **Source:** `src/MoonsteelPretty/`
- **Ships:** `Zenderal - Moonsteel Pretty Patch.esp` + 2 loose meshes
- **FormID block:** none (overrides only)

## What it does

**GENERATED by `src/MoonsteelPretty/tools/01-build-moonsteel-overrides.py` — never hand-edit `Weapons/`, `Ammunitions/`, `Projectiles/`.** Pretty Common Armory's Moonsteel meshes never showed: EGO renames base Enderal's Silver Steel line ("Moonsteel") and repoints all of it at vanilla Dragonborn's `DLC02\Weapons\Nordic\*`, while Pretty replaces the meshes at base Enderal's paths (`Weapons\NordHero\*`, `Enderal\weapons\Silberstahldolch.nif`) **inside its BSA** — a mesh replacer works by path, so MO2 priority cannot help. Pretty also overrides the three battleaxe records with base Enderal's, which reverted EGO's name/stats on them. 22 overrides = EGO's record verbatim with `ObjectBounds`/`Model`/`FirstPersonModel` from the base-Enderal record: dagger/sword/greatsword/war axe/battleaxe/bow (base + Forged + enchanted, incl. EGO's own `001F41/42/74/94` variants), EGO's Silver Arrow `001D03:EGO` (← Fine Steel Arrow's `NordHeroArrow.nif`) and its projectile `001D02:EGO` (← `0EAFE0`'s `NordHeroArrowProjectile.nif`). Deliberately NOT changed: EGO's Moonsteel mace/warhammer (`005E71–74:EGO`, no base counterpart, no Pretty mesh) and Tharael's Bow `02C5E9:FS`. Built plugin checked against the LIVE EGO `.esp`: every non-mesh subrecord byte-identical. **Quiver:** `Enderal Remastered Armory Part 1 - Standard Armory` ships both NordHero arrow meshes LOOSE, which beats Pretty's BSA, so `tools/02-extract-pretty-arrow.py` writes Pretty's two files loose into the MO2 mod (not committed); the mod must sort above ERA Part 1 — side effect: base Fine Steel Arrow (same mesh) also gets Pretty's quiver. Masters: Skyrim + EGO + `Pretty Common Armory.esp` (forces load-after). Built and deployed to Alpha 0.5 2026-10-12, not yet verified in game; rebuild CRDW.
